project_info.creative_direction: Digital composite that makes a portrait continue through large stacked serif typography
project_info.color_palette: pure white, black, charcoal gray, and mid-gray continuous monochrome tones

main_subject.detail: approved adult fictional male subject in a close-up front-facing portrait with slight head tilt, contemplative gaze, short textured hair, faint stubble, and natural facial detail
main_subject.wardrobe: dark jacket or suit collar visible at the lower edge
main_subject.identity: generic fictional adult identity with no public-figure likeness

composition_elements.framing: eye-level close-up, face filling the height on the left half of a vertical poster
composition_elements.split_effect: right half is white negative space where the face continues through large bold vertically stacked serif letters
composition_elements.typography: IF YOU DREAM IT YOU CAN DO IT. in uppercase heavy slab serif, with the letter fill carrying grayscale facial and hair texture
composition_elements.relationship: text alignment must match the underlying facial anatomy to preserve the split-face illusion

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: hard side key at approximately 5000K with deep chiaroscuro and minimal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: high-contrast facial modeling, visible pores and stubble, sharp type edges, and intense visionary mood

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 85mm telephoto lens, photoreal black-and-white portrait combined with graphic design
technical_specs.finish: deep grayscale, natural film grain, sharp serif cuts, realistic skin texture, and clean white background

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-contrast black-and-white split-composition portrait of a clearly adult fictional man. The left half displays a realistic high-detail close-up photograph of the right side of his face, with short textured hair, faint stubble, natural skin detail, and an intense contemplative gaze. The right half is a pure white background where the left side of his face is revealed only through large bold vertically stacked serif typography reading IF YOU DREAM IT YOU CAN DO IT. The letterforms should be filled with grayscale hair and skin texture so the face continues through the type. Use eye-level framing, hard approximately 5000K side lighting, dramatic chiaroscuro, an 85mm telephoto lens, visible film grain, and a visionary motivational poster mood. Use a wholly fictional adult identity with no public-figure likeness, real name, or logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure name, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed face, misaligned typography, unreadable quote, broken split-face anatomy
